# Contributing to apigen

## Development setup

```bash
git clone https://github.com/ilbertt/apigen
cd apigen
bun install
bun check:all      # types + lint/format
bun run test       # run all tests
bun run build      # build the publishable package
```

## Commit messages

We use [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) for commit messages to the main branch. Make sure your PR title is in the correct format.
